Container.Name: crayon-box-sync
Container.Overview: Family sync for Crayon Box, the kids' coloring app (ADR 0024). Keeps kid profiles, settings and pictures the same on every paired device. Home network only: do not expose it to the internet. Open the WebUI for the pairing code. Optional: an OpenRouter key turns on AI coloring pages for the family.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Where the app reaches the server

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database and pictures. Include it in your appdata backup.

Config.Name: Pairing code
Config.Description: Optional: a fixed pairing code. Leave empty to use the one the server makes on first start (shown on the WebUI).

Config.Name: OpenRouter API key
Config.Description: Optional: turns on AI pages for the whole family (ADR 0029). Make a key just for this app at openrouter.ai, with a credit limit. It stays in this container's settings only.

Config.Name: AI pages a day
Config.Description: The most AI pages the family can make in a day.

Config.Name: Image model
Config.Description: The family's default OpenRouter model with image output, for pages from a photo or an idea. A parent can pick another in the app.

Config.Name: Second image model
Config.Description: The other model when a parent asks for two pages to choose from.

Config.Name: Drawing model
Config.Description: An OpenRouter text model that draws pages as SVG line art.
